note: Grounded in the three selection handlers (unpublished, unpublished_media, unpublished_taxonomy_term) and the field-config setting that selects them (settings.handler). Medium/hard cases create namespaced entity_reference fields (field_eru_*) on node.article targeting node or taxonomy_term and read/write field.field settings.handler. Cleanup deletes only the field_eru_* storages it created. node and taxonomy_term are core; no media dependency is required.

evals.prompt: The entity_reference_unpublished module adds selection handlers so a reference field can point at unpublished content. What are the three handler (plugin) ids it provides and which entity type does each target?
How do I make an existing node entity-reference field able to reference unpublished nodes using entity_reference_unpublished? What do I change on the field?
evals.expected_output: Edit the field and set its Reference method (the selection handler) to 'Unpublished Default'; in config this sets the field's settings.handler to 'unpublished'.

evals.prompt: Why do the entity_reference_unpublished handlers return unpublished entities when core's normal node/media/term reference handlers do not? What base class do they extend?
evals.expected_output: They extend the generic DefaultSelection base class instead of the entity-specific handlers (NodeSelection/MediaSelection/TermSelection) that add a published-only (status = 1) query condition, so that condition is never applied and unpublished entities are returned.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an entity-reference field field_eru_known that points at nodes. Inspect the live field configuration and tell me which entity-reference selection handler it uses.
evals.expected_output: unpublished: field.field.node.article.field_eru_known has settings.handler = 'unpublished' (Unpublished Default), so it can reference unpublished nodes.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a taxonomy-term reference field field_eru_terms configured with entity_reference_unpublished. Inspect the live field configuration and state the selection handler id it uses.

Using entity_reference_unpublished, reconfigure the field so it can reference unpublished nodes. Apply the change to the live field configuration.
